WITH totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) as total_artifacts
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.zoneref,
    sf.articount,
    sf.articount * 1.0 / t.total_artifacts as share
  FROM scanfeatures sf
  CROSS JOIN totals t
  WHERE sf.articount IS NOT NULL
    AND t.total_artifacts IS NOT NULL
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  s.zoneref,
  s.articount,
  s.share,
  s.share - a.avg_share as diff_from_avg
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.share - a.avg_share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
